evals.prompt: Export every Qogita Fini conversation from the last 30 days with messages and used articles. There are probably more than 100.
evals.expected_output: A cursor-based export plan or execution that uses pages of at most 100, continues until hasMore is false, preserves evidence, and reports completeness and a resume cursor.
assertions: Treats 100 as the page-size ceiling rather than the total export ceiling
Uses nextCursor with direction=next until hasMore is false or an explicit bound is reached
Reports pages, total records, time window, and final cursor or timestamp
Does not fetch every conversation again when list results already contain the requested evidence

evals.prompt: Pull a quick sample of the latest 20 conversations for one bot and tell me which KB articles caused bad answers.
evals.expected_output: A bounded read-only QA workflow that resolves the bot, inspects events and used articles, and routes content versus configuration failures correctly.
assertions: Uses a bounded recent window and the target botId
Preserves conversation IDs and used-article evidence
Separates knowledge gaps from prompt, rule, or metadata problems

evals.prompt: Send this customer question to the bot and show me its answer.
evals.expected_output: Routes to fini-api-generate-answer rather than treating the request as a conversation export.
assertions: Does not use the conversation listing workflow to create a new turn
Routes the request to fini-api-generate-answer

evals.prompt: This Fini answer was wrong. Run fix review on the answer, show me the proposed correction, and update the bot automatically.
evals.expected_output: Runs fix review on the exact answer event, reports the replay and recommendations, but does not claim the recommendations were applied automatically.
assertions: Identifies the exact conversation and Fini response event with role=finibot
Compares the original and replay answers
Treats fix-review recommendations as proposals rather than applied configuration
Routes an accepted change to the owning skill and its approval gate

evals.prompt: Thumb this Fini answer down, add the note that it missed the 30-day exception, and mark it resolved.
evals.expected_output: Targets the exact conversation and Fini response event, treats rating, note, and resolution as separate writes, and verifies each resulting signal.
assertions: Uses approved=false for the thumbs-down rating rather than calling it configuration approval
Uses the feedback-note workflow for the qualitative note
Uses the resolution workflow separately and does not imply that it clears the rating or note
Re-reads or reports event rating, note, event resolution, and conversation resolution separately

evals.prompt: Why did this agent's CSAT and resolution rate fall last month? Show the trend and a few conversations that explain it.
evals.expected_output: Routes aggregate performance analysis to agent analytics with an explicit period and filters, then uses bounded conversation evidence for diagnosis.
assertions: Uses fini-api-agents for aggregate CSAT and resolution trends
Does not infer workspace-wide trends from an arbitrary conversation sample
Returns to a bounded conversation export for representative evidence
Keeps event CSAT, thumbs rating, notes, and resolution fields distinct

evals.prompt: Replay this bad Fini response with the proposed fix and make it a permanent regression test.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the exact source conversation and Fini response event for Replay diagnosis, validates an unpublished exact-ID fix separately, then reruns a persistent Test Set against the published live agent.
assertions: Requires the exact Fini response event and checks for a linked user event
Keeps the source conversation and replay conversation IDs distinct
Routes replay creation and comparison to fini-api-testing
Does not claim that creating a replay automatically adds a Test Set case
Uses fini-api-draft-validation when the proposed fix is still unpublished
Uses an eligible source conversation as a persistent case only after verifying its inputs and expected behavior
States that the post-publish Test Set run evaluates live behavior and may invoke Actions or external APIs

evals.prompt: Reopen the previously resolved issue on this exact negatively rated Fini response, but keep its thumbs-down rating and teammate note.
evals.expected_output: Uses resolved=false on the exact conversation and finibot event, keeps the rating and note unchanged, and verifies event plus conversation resolution.
assertions: Uses resolved=false to mark the issue unresolved or reopened
Does not clear or rewrite the thumbs-down rating
Does not clear or rewrite the teammate note
Re-reads or reports event and conversation resolution after the writes

evals.prompt: Delete conversations 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 and 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222. Those are the exact two IDs and I confirm the deletion.
evals.expected_output: Uses the caller's explicit exact-target authorization, warns that bulk deletion is non-atomic, deletes only those two IDs, and verifies the response without asking for duplicate confirmation.
assertions: Uses only the two exact supplied conversation IDs
Does not ask for duplicate confirmation
Treats the operation as destructive and explains non-atomic partial-effect behavior
Reports which IDs were attempted and the API response evidence
Does not expand deletion to related conversations or resources

evals.prompt: Clear the thumbs rating and teammate note on this exact Fini response. Do not change anything else.
evals.expected_output: Uses approved=null and an empty feedback value as separate writes on the exact finibot event, leaves resolution untouched, and verifies the resulting signals.
assertions: Uses approved=null to clear the thumbs rating
Uses an empty feedback value to clear only the teammate note
Does not write the resolved field
Does not imply that clearing one field clears the other
Re-reads or reports rating, note, and aggregate conversation resolution

evals.prompt: Explain why this exact Fini response used this article, selected these tags, and ran this Attribute and Rule. Read-only.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the exact Fini-authored event and uses its stored event metadata once to produce an evidence-based RCA without replaying or changing anything.
assertions: Resolves the event through its conversation and verifies role=finibot
Fetches metadata only for the exact selected event rather than sweeping the export
When using the direct API, calls GET /v2/hc-events/{id}/metadata without adding a /public suffix
Interprets planning, knowledge, answer reasoning, tags, executed Attributes, and executed Rules only when returned
Treats null sections as absent or not recorded rather than inventing a failure
Does not Replay, Generate Answer, evaluate a Rule, execute an Action, or mutate configuration
Redacts unnecessary Attribute and external-step payload data
Routes the diagnosed issue to the correct owning skill
